name: check-on-edit
description: After each edit, runs your project's own linter on that file (eslint, biome, ruff, gofmt, go vet, shellcheck) and hands the problems back to Claude in the same turn.

typecheck.title: Typecheck too
typecheck.description: Also run tsc (TypeScript) or mypy (Python) after each edit, showing only errors in the edited file. Slower on big projects.

command.title: Your own check
command.description: A command to run instead of the built-in checks, with {file} for the edited file, e.g. 'npx eslint {file}'. Leave empty to detect.
